summary: High‑engagement posts from similar creators use bold, relatable claims and clear CTAs (e.g., “comment X for a free guide”). Single‑image quotes with punchy hooks and a playful tone drive likes and comments, while carousel tutorials add value and keep viewers swiping.
notes: Hook ideas: • “Claude just learned to design my coffee logo – and it only took 30 seconds ☕🤖” (ties to Claude Opus 5.5). • “Think GPT‑6 can’t help with your grocery list? Think again – 3 steps to a AI‑powered list 🛒✨”. Use a CTA like “comment ‘COFFEE’ for a free prompt sheet”. Visual style: bright background, bold sans‑serif text overlay, a small doodle or emoji that illustrates the claim, and a tiny brand logo in the corner. Keep captions under 150 characters, start with a playful statement, follow with a simple benefit, then the CTA. Leverage trending headlines by framing them as everyday wins (“Your phone can now run AI‑powered shortcuts thanks to Snapdragon X2 – here’s how to set one up in 3 taps”). Post 3‑4 times a week: 2 single‑image quotes with strong hooks and CTAs, 1 carousel tutorial, 1 quick before/after carousel. Engage early: reply to first 20 comments with emojis to boost algorithmic reach.
